fields.title: PSA certificate / sale record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType discriminates the payload: CERT (the graded item with its population, PSA estimate and sales summary), SALE (one comparable sale), SURFACE (reference mode) and ERROR. Prices and counts are parsed to numbers and dates to YYYY-MM-DD, with the published values kept under _raw.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The certification number that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

certNumber.title: Certification number
certNumber.description: The number printed on the PSA label. On SALE rows this is the certificate of the card that sold.

certUrl.title: Certificate URL
certUrl.description: Public verification page for the certificate.

gradeNumber.title: Grade number
gradeNumber.description: Numeric part of the grade, for sorting and filtering.

year.title: Year
year.description: Year of the card or item.

brand.title: Brand / set
brand.description: Brand and set title, e.g. 'PANINI PRIZM EMERGENT'.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Player, character or subject on the card.

varietyPedigree.title: Variety / pedigree
varietyPedigree.description: Variety or pedigree noted on the label.

labelType.title: Label type
labelType.description: Which PSA label generation the holder carries.

reverseCertBarcode.title: Reverse cert / barcode
reverseCertBarcode.description: Whether the holder carries a reverse certificate barcode.

psaEstimate.title: PSA estimate
psaEstimate.description: PSA's own published value estimate for the item at this grade, as a number.

psaEstimateRaw.title: PSA estimate (as published)
psaEstimateRaw.description: The estimate exactly as printed, e.g. '$60.00'.

psaPopulation.title: Population
psaPopulation.description: How many of this item PSA has graded at this grade.

psaPopHigher.title: Population higher
psaPopHigher.description: How many copies PSA has graded higher than this one. Zero means nothing beats it.

populationReportUrl.title: Population report URL
populationReportUrl.description: Link to the full population report for the set. That report itself requires a PSA account.

recentSalesCount.title: Comparable sales
recentSalesCount.description: How many comparable sales the certificate page lists.

recentSaleMin.title: Lowest comparable sale
recentSaleMin.description: Lowest price among the listed comparable sales.

recentSaleMax.title: Highest comparable sale
recentSaleMax.description: Highest price among the listed comparable sales.

recentSaleAvg.title: Average comparable sale
recentSaleAvg.description: Mean of the listed comparable sales - a plain average, with no outlier handling.

latestSaleDate.title: Latest sale date
latestSaleDate.description: Date of the most recent comparable sale, YYYY-MM-DD.

sourceCertNumber.title: Looked-up certificate
sourceCertNumber.description: On SALE rows, the certificate whose page this sale was listed on.

saleIndex.title: Sale position
saleIndex.description: Position of the sale in the published list, newest first.

soldDateRaw.title: Sold date (as published)
soldDateRaw.description: Sale date exactly as printed, MM/DD/YY.

seller.title: Marketplace
seller.description: Where the sale happened, e.g. eBay or an auction house.

grade.title: Sold item grade
grade.description: Grade of the item that sold, e.g. 'PSA 10'.

imageUrl.title: Image
imageUrl.description: Listing image for the sold item, where published.

url.title: Probed URL
url.description: Exact URL used for the probe.

isAvailable.title: Available
isAvailable.description: Whether the source answered with usable data right now.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Evidence measured during the probe, including which connection profile got through.

_tlsProfile.title: Connection profile
_tlsProfile.description: Which connection profile the run used. Useful when diagnosing a sudden wave of refusals.

_raw.title: Raw published values
_raw.description: The certificate's published fields exactly as printed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: Graded items with population and value.
